name: Herno Navy Strength
base_ingredient: Same distilled gin as Hernö Dry Gin
production: Hernö gin distillate diluted to 57% instead of 40.5%
history: 2011 | Hernö Gin founded by Jon Hillgren, Sweden's first dedicated gin distillery
serve_official: Gibson Martini; or Indian tonic with lemon zest
notes: Gin Guild says flavour info was provided by the brand owner. Full botanical list not given here (Hernö Dry botanicals listed on Old Tom/Sloe pages).
